7.4.3.5.2.4 Binary Manifest
The implementation of the Dem High Proxy may require some basic infrastructure
from the Dem Low Proxy in order to be operational. Such generic infrastructure ser-
vices can be linked between Application Software Cluster and Host Soft-
ware Cluster by means of a Dem base socket.
